## Runs 6–7 — `sdh-spot-check`, electron (n = +3.2×10¹²) and hole (n = −1.2×10¹²) at D = 0

**Raw first:** both traces are complete and the channel never rails (max 530–590 Ω on a 5 kΩ full scale). The drain current holds at 9.8–9.9 nA and T_sample stays at base. The electron trace dips to −33 Ω near 6 T, which points to a Hall/inhomogeneity admixture on the B_1–B_2 pair. That fits the two series doping regions seen in run 5 (ridge B, Δn ≈ 0.43×10¹²), and it is a mosaic caveat carried forward.

**Onset and tones:** `sdh_onset` on the adequately sampled record (run 6 at 10 mT from 1 T; the 50 mT points below 1 T are sub-Nyquist for a 7 T tone):
- **Electron side, run 6:** a 7.3 T tone is still above threshold at 1.0 T (censored, so its onset is ≤ 1 T). The dominant 29.4 T tone has onset ≈ 1.8 T, with further tones at 14.9, 22.4 and 37 T. The ratio-only screen flags these as a 7.3 T comb (2×, 3×, 4×). But 7.3 + 29.4 = 36.7 T ≈ 1.11·F_L (33.1 T), which sits inside the lever-arm scale prior. The model's ABAB pair here is 7.3 + 25.8 T, and ABCA is a single 33.1 T tone. The recipe's Luttinger-aware screen forbids discarding the 7.3 T tone on its ratio alone: n-dependence decides.
- **Hole side, run 7 (onset ≈ 0.5 T, censored):** tones at 6.8, 4.6, 8.5 and 12.3 T (≈ F_L). This is the near-CNP semimetal regime, where the model's ABAB pair is close and balanced (5.9 / 6.5 T). A tone at F_L is the expected breakdown/sum confound, and the ABCA tone here would carry m* ≈ 1.1 mₑ, which is LK-dead at this rig's T_e.

**Read:** one density per side cannot separate "pair + sum" from "singleton + comb". The spot checks settle three design facts: (1) SdH is resolvable from ~1 T (light tone) and ~1.8 T (dominant tone); (2) only the electron side reaches the |n| ≳ 2–3×10¹² design window, because the hole side is capped at −1.27×10¹² by the TG limit; (3) 50 µV sensitivity and a 10τ dwell are clean. **No stacking call from these.** Next: the electron-side D = 0 fan (Step 4), which reads each tone's n-dependence and the partition sum across density.

# Runs 6-7 — sdh-spot-check read (raw first, then onset + FFT vs F_L and the FS-count model).
import sys, os, warnings
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset, resolve_channels
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.expanduser("~/measurement_env/hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count"))
import fs_count_b0 as fsm

def rxx(i):
    r = run(i); ch = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); R = (r.col("sr1_X") / ch["sr1"].gain) / (r.col("sr0_X") / ch["sr0"].gain)
    o = np.argsort(B); return r, B[o], R[o]

spots = [(6, +3.2, 1.0), (7, -1.2, 0.5)]   # (run, n [1e12], onset-analysis b_lo: run 6 below 1 T is 50 mT = sub-Nyquist for a 7 T tone)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(16, 8))
for k, (rid, n12, blo) in enumerate(spots):
    r, B, R = rxx(rid)
    FL = float(luttinger_frequency(abs(n12) * 1e16)); fs = 50e-6 / 9.9e-9
    print(f"run {rid}: n = {n12:+.1f}e12, D = 0, T {np.nanmean(r.col('T_sample')):.2f} K, R {R.min():.0f}..{R.max():.0f} Ohm (FS {fs:.0f}), F_L = {FL:.1f} T, interrupted={r.interrupted}")
    with warnings.catch_warnings():
        warnings.simplefilter("ignore"); on = sdh_onset(R, B, b_lo=blo, r_full_scale=fs)
    print(on.summary())
    ab = fsm.abab_mstar(n12 * 1e16); ca = fsm.abca_mstar(n12 * 1e16)
    print("  model ABAB (F, m*): " + ", ".join(f"({F:.1f} T, {m:.3f})" for F, m in ab) + f";  ABCA ({ca[0]:.1f} T, {ca[1]:.3f})\n")
    ax[k, 0].plot(B, R, lw=.7); ax[k, 0].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="Rxx B_1-B_2 (Ohm)", title=f"run {rid} raw, n = {n12:+.1f}e12, D = 0")
    sel = B > 1.5; dR = R[sel] - np.polyval(np.polyfit(B[sel], R[sel], 5), B[sel])
    ax[k, 1].plot(1 / B[sel], dR, lw=.7); ax[k, 1].set(xlabel="1/B (1/T)", ylabel="dR (Ohm)", title="deg-5 B-space background removed, B > 1.5 T")
    for lo in ((1.0, 1.8, 3.0) if rid == 6 else (0.7, 1.5, 2.5)):
        f, s = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(lo, 10.0), bg_degree=5, log=False)
        m = f > 1.5; ax[k, 2].plot(f, s[0] / s[0][m].max(), label=f"[{lo}, 10] T")
    ax[k, 2].axvline(FL, color="k", ls="--", label="F_L")
    for F, _ in ab: ax[k, 2].axvline(F, color="C3", ls=":", lw=1)
    ax[k, 2].axvline(ca[0], color="C2", ls="-.", lw=1)
    ax[k, 2].set(xlim=(0, 2 * FL), ylim=(0, 1.05), xlabel="F (T)", title="FFT (red dotted ABAB, green ABCA, black F_L)"); ax[k, 2].legend(fontsize=7)
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side, D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`, investigation `tetralayer-stacking-fs-count`)

> **05:25** · landau-fan-vti e-side D=0: n +1.60..+3.25e12 (38 pts, Vtg +0.525..+0.998, Vbg +0.573..+1.185) fast x B 1.0->7.5 T uniform-1/B (89 rows, d(1/B)=0.0099) slow; sr1 50 uV, tau 0.1 s/24 dB, dwell 1.0 s; ends at 7.5 T, gates parked · **ETA ~07:40** (≈2h15m)

**Why this fan:** one density per side cannot separate "ABAB pair + sum tone" from "ABCA singleton + harmonic comb" (ana, runs 6–7). At +3.2×10¹² the spot check shows 7.3 T and 29.4 T tones. The model's ABAB pair is 7.3 + 25.8 T and ABCA's single tone is 33.1 T. The fan reads each tone's n-dependence and the partition sum f₁ + f₂ = F_L across density in one object. The 7.3 T tone either follows its own Onsager curve (ABAB partner) or stays locked at ¼ of the dominant tone (a harmonic comb). **Side:** electron. Within the TG limit the hole side reaches only −1.27×10¹², which is the recipe's near-CNP exception regime where the ABAB pair is balanced and beat-like. The electron side is the only one that reaches the |n| ≳ 2–3×10¹² design window.

**Design (the floored proposal).**
- **Field window.** B_lo = 1.0 T is the `sdh_onset` value on run 6's 10 mT record. It is censored, because the light tone is still alive at the record edge; below 1 T, run 6 was sampled at 50 mT, which is too coarse for a 7 T tone. B_hi = 7.5 T sits just below the QH-scale jump at ~7.7 T in run 6 (ν ≈ 17 at n_hi). Rows above that add harmonics, not resolution: δF changes by only 0.04 T, and stopping at 7.5 T instead of 10 T saves ~25 min.
- **B axis.** Uniform in 1/B with Δ(1/B) = 1/(3·F_L(n_hi)) = 0.0099 T⁻¹ gives **N_B = 89**. The Nyquist frequency is 50.8 T, which clears F_L = 33.6 T including a ×1.2 scale error and the region-B density offset (+0.43×10¹²).
- **n axis.** **N_n = 38** over n = 1.60 → 3.25×10¹². Steps are Δn = 0.045×10¹², i.e. 2.2 points per Landau level at B_lo, so the ray-Nyquist floor holds. n_hi keeps 2 mV under the TG limit.
- **Resolution.** The light tone's record gives δF = 1.15 T. The dominant tone's record (from its ~1.8 T onset) gives δF = 2.3 T, so it separates from F_L by more than 2δF wherever the ABAB heavy tone is predicted at 0.79–0.82·F_L, i.e. n ≳ 2.3×10¹². The partner gets ≥ 5 periods at n ≳ 2.8×10¹² and ~3–4 periods at 1.6–2.4×10¹². The low-n columns buy trajectory lever arm, not standalone reads.
- **Dynamic range.** Sensitivity stays at 50 µV (5 kΩ full scale), as in runs 6–7. Their worst case was 590 Ω, and the low-n × 7.5 T corner is estimated at ≲ 1.5 kΩ, leaving ≥ 3× headroom.
- **Settling.** τ changes from 0.3 s to **0.1 s** (24 dB) on sr0 and sr1, with a 1.0 s dwell. That is 10τ, the same settled fraction as the spot checks (3 s at τ = 0.3), at √3 wider noise bandwidth; runs 6–7 tone SNR was 50–130. This halves the grid cost against 3 s/pt. `close_out(restore=state0)` puts τ back to 0.3 s.
- **Price.** 1.10 s/pt at a 1.0 s dwell (run 5) × 3382 points = 62 min. Traverse 1 → 7.5 T at 0.137 T/min (runs 6–7) = 47 min. Row overhead (3 s magnet settle + 2 s slow_delay + 1.3 s flyback) = 10 min. Positioning 0 → 1 T = 7 min. Session actuals run +5–10% over estimates.

**Excluded coverage:** the hole side (limited by the gate cap), n < 1.6×10¹² (the ABAB/ABCA templates merge within the scale prior), and B > 7.5 T (QH regime). Guards: a leak trip at 1 nA, a T trip at 2 K, and a rail warning at 0.9 of full scale. Gates park at 0 on exit, and the field stays at 7.5 T for the next step (the LK mass split or a firming fan), so the magnet is never re-traversed.

**Checkpoints:**
- **First rows** (~10 min, B = 1.0 T): sr1 is not railed, the gate currents sit at their pA offsets, I_drain ≈ 9.9 nA, and the R(n) profile matches run 6 at 3.2×10¹² (≈ 10–60 Ω). Abort on any failure.
- **Row ~51** (~1 h, B ≈ 2 T): Landau-level fan lines visible in the raw map's high-n columns. If they are absent while run 6 had them, abort; that saves ~75 min.
- **Row ~77** (~1 h 35 m, B ≈ 4.1 T): a partial per-column FFT on [1.0, 4.1] T to check the dominant tone against F_L across n. Continue unless the channel rails.

# === Landau fan, electron side, D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`): n +1.60 -> +3.25e12 (38) fast x B 1.0 -> 7.5 T uniform-1/B (89 rows) slow ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
N_LO, N_HI, N_N, D0 = 1.60, 3.25, 38, 0.0          # 1e12 cm^-2, V/nm
ns = np.linspace(N_LO, N_HI, N_N)
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, D0 * np.ones_like(ns), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
Vtgs, Vbgs = np.asarray(Vtgs, float), np.asarray(Vbgs, float)
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vtgs.max(), Vbgs.max())
_n_chk, _D_chk = calc_nD(Vtgs, Vbgs, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
print(f"n-line: {N_N} pts, n {ns[0]:+.3f} -> {ns[-1]:+.3f}e12 (dn {ns[1]-ns[0]:.4f}e12), D = {D0:+.2f} V/nm (roundtrip max|D| {np.max(np.abs(_D_chk)):.1e}); "
      f"Vtg {Vtgs[0]:+.4f} -> {Vtgs[-1]:+.4f} V, Vbg {Vbgs[0]:+.4f} -> {Vbgs[-1]:+.4f} V")

# --- field axis: uniform in 1/B (per-column SdH-FFT fan), dinvB = 1/(3 F_L(n_hi)) ---
B_LO, B_HI, N_B = 1.0, 7.5, 89
B_vec = 1.0 / np.linspace(1.0 / B_LO, 1.0 / B_HI, N_B)          # ascending 1.0 -> 7.5 T
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0)
print(f"B axis: {N_B} rows {B_vec[0]:.3f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.3f} T, d(1/B) {(1/B_LO-1/B_HI)/(N_B-1):.5f} 1/T (Nyquist F {0.5*(N_B-1)/(1/B_LO-1/B_HI):.1f} T; F_L(n_hi) = 33.6 T)")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _Tv, _B0 = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), T_vap = {_Tv:.3f} K, B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: handoff left 0 T), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"heater ranges {heater.sample_range()}/{heater.vaporizer_range()} (0/0), PS {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, "
      f"nplci tg/bg {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert heater.sample_range() == 0 and heater.vaporizer_range() == 0, "heaters not off"
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1

# --- lock-in: fixed for the whole fan. 50 uV = 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA (inherited from runs 6-7); tau 0.1 s x 24 dB, dwell 1.0 s = 10 tau ---
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
sr0.time_constant(0.1); sr1.time_constant(0.1)
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.0, 2.0
print(f"drive {sr1.amplitude()} V; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s / {sr1.filter_slope()} dB; "
      f"sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr0.time_constant()} s / {sr0.filter_slope()} dB; fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s")
assert sr1.filter_slope() == 24 and sr0.filter_slope() == 24
I_TRIP, T_TRIP = 1e-9, 2.0

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan-vti electron D=0: n {N_LO:+.2f}..{N_HI:+.2f}e12 ({N_N}) fast, B {B_LO}->{B_HI} T uniform-1/B ({N_B}) slow, "
                  f"sr1 50 uV, tau 0.1 s, fast_delay 1.0 s; cal run 5")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'D = {D0} V/nm, n = {N_LO} to {N_HI} (1e12 cm^-2, {N_N} pts), B = {B_LO} to {B_HI} T uniform in 1/B ({N_B} rows, '
              f'd(1/B) = 1/(3 F_L(n_hi))); tetralayer-stacking-fs-count Step 4; cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, '
              f'n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.4f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f} V/nm; spot checks runs 6-7')

# --- position: field first (blocking ramp 0 -> 1.0 T, ~7.5 min), then gates to the row start ---
magnet.field(B_vec[0])
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)
print(f"positioned: B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}) V")

# row layout: [time, B, Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

_rail = {"n": 0}
def fan_guard(station, data):
    T, i_tg, i_bg, x1 = float(data[4]), abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6])), abs(float(data[9]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f}, Vbg={float(data[3]):+.4f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
    if T > T_TRIP:
        print(f"T TRIP at B={float(data[1]):.3f} T: T_sample = {T:.3f} K > {T_TRIP} K")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
    if x1 > 0.9 * 50e-6 and _rail["n"] < 5:
        _rail["n"] += 1
        print(f"RAIL WARN at B={float(data[1]):.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f}: |sr1.X| = {x1:.3e} V (>0.9 FS)")
s.register_run_after(fan_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs], slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
    # field stays where the fan ended (7.5 T on completion) -- the next step decides; never re-traverse blind.
    print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}) V, T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K")
